name: sync
description: SYNC: synchronized music listening rooms for the GUAP IT hackathon.

scripts.dev: npm run build -w @sync/shared && concurrently -k -n shared,server,web -c yellow,cyan,green "npm run dev -w @sync/shared" "npm run dev -w @sync/server" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @sync/shared && npm run build -w @sync/server && npm run build -w web
scripts.start: concurrently -k -n server,web "npm run start -w @sync/server" "npm run start -w web"
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @sync/shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces && tsc -p tsconfig.tools.json
